instincts.trigger: Advantage+ Shopping (ASC) kampaniyasi yoqilganda yoki audit qilinganda
instincts.action: Existing Customer Budget Cap ko'rsatkichini 25-30% qilib cheklang, aks holda algoritm byudjetni issiq retargeting bazasiga sarflab yuboradi.

instincts.trigger: Meta Ads ad set byudjeti va soni rejalashtirilganda
instincts.action: Har bir ad set haftasiga kamida 50 ta konversiya olishi uchun kunlik byudjet >= (Target CPA * 50 / 7) bo'lsin; 48 soatda byudjetni >20% oshirmang.

instincts.trigger: Google Ads Performance Max (PMax) kampaniyasi qidiruv (Search) bilan birga ishlaganda
instincts.action: Account-level Brand Exclusions ro'yxatini yoqing, aks holda PMax brend qidiruv trafigini o'zlashtirib ROAS'ni sun'iy ko'rsatadi.

instincts.trigger: Telegram Ads rasmiy auksioni uchun reklama matni yozilganda
instincts.action: Matn qat'iy <=160 belgi, ko'pi bilan 1 ta kontekstga mos emoji va ALL CAPS so'zlarsiz bo'lsin; bot havolasida ?start=utm_source_campaign_angle bo'lsin.

instincts.trigger: Meta Pixel va Server CAPI birgalikda ishlatilganda
instincts.action: Browser va Server hodisalari bir xil event_id bilan deduplikatsiya qilinishi va EMQ >= 7.0 bo'lishi shart.

instincts.trigger: O'zbekiston bozori uchun reklama matni va kreativ tayyorlanganda
instincts.action: O'zbek (lotin), Kirill va Rus tillarida matnni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tarjima qilmasdan, har bir segment tilida alohida yozing va ad setlarni til bo'yicha ajrating.
First-Time Impression Ratio (FTIR) < 60% ga tushsa va Frequency > 2.8 bo'lsa, kreativ charchagan hisoblanadi — yangi burchak (angle) kiriting.

instincts.trigger: YAML frontmatter yoki JSON sozlamalarda fayl yo'li yozilganda
instincts.action: Hech qachon qo'shtirnoq ichida Windows backslash (D:\tyrion) ishlatmang (\t TAB belgisiga aylanib faylni buzadi); har doim D:/tyrion yozing.

instincts.trigger: Meta Ads auditoriyasi (TOF/MOF/BOF) yoki O'zbekiston bo'yicha kampaniya qurilganda
instincts.action: Toshkent va viloyatlarni alohida kampaniyaga ajrating, UZ/RU tillarni alohida ad set qiling, TOF dan Purchase_180d va LeadForm_90d ni Exclude qiling hamda Overlap <= 20% bo'lishini meta-audience.py bilan tekshiring.
